================================================================================
PART 2: WHATUNITY RESIDENTIAL OPERATING SYSTEM (TECHNICAL SPEC)
================================================================================

## System Overview
- Product Name: WhatsUnity (واتس يونيتي)
- Core Value Proposition: One home. One subscription. Your entire household included. (منزل واحد. اشتراك واحد. عائلتك بالكامل مشمولة.)
- Category: Gated Community Operating System & Multi-tenant Property Platform.
- Production Status: 34+ production-ready screens across 9 tailored operational roles.
- Time-to-Deploy: Turnkey deployment in under 48 hours for new compounds.

## 1. Clean Architecture Boundaries (Zero Code-Gen)
WhatsUnity enforces strict Clean Architecture:
- Presentation Layer: Flutter UI widgets with responsive RTL/LTR adaptation, driven by Dart 3 Cubits/BLoCs.
- Domain Layer: Pure Dart entities, sealed Result<T, Failure> classes, Use Cases, and abstract Repository contracts with 0 Flutter imports.
- Data Layer: Repositories coordinating SQLite Local Master and remote APIs (Appwrite & Telegram).
- Exclusion of code generators: `build_runner` and `freezed` are completely eliminated in favor of Dart 3 native pattern matching, records, and sealed class hierarchies.

## 2. SQLite Local Master (Offline-First 0ms Latency)
- All client mutations write immediately to local SQLite with `sync_state = 'dirty'`.
- UI observes local database tables, delivering 0ms UI reactions with zero network wait spinners.
- Background sync worker batches dirty mutations, pushes to Appwrite Cloud using optimistic concurrency, and applies Last-Write-Wins (LWW) with incremental entity versioning.

## 3. Dual-Engine Messaging Architecture
- Abstract `ChatRepository` interface enables runtime selection:
  1. Appwrite Realtime WebSocket Engine: Premium low-latency chat with live presence, read receipts, and typing indicators.
  2. Telegram MTProto Engine: Zero cloud database hosting costs for budget-conscious communities, routing community feeds via official Telegram Bot APIs.

## 4. Cryptographic Offline Gate Security
- Visitor QR passes embed encrypted unit ID, visitor credentials, expiration timestamp, and HMAC digital signatures.
- Gatekeeper tablets validate signatures locally in <50ms without internet access.
- Local overstay vehicle tracking and NFC patrol checkpoint logging operate seamlessly during network blackouts.

## 5. 9-Role Governance Matrix
1. Residents (الوحدات السكنية والسكان): One household subscription, QR visitor pass generation, direct ticket filing.
2. Gatekeepers (أفراد أمن البوابات): Offline sub-50ms QR pass verification, manual visitor entry, overstay warnings.
3. Patrol Guards (دوريات الأمن المتنقلة): NFC checkpoint scans, incident reporting with photos.
4. Head of Security (رئيس الأمن): Live guard tracking, perimeter status, incident dispatch.
5. Maintenance Coordinators (منسقو الصيانة): Ticket triage, priority tagging, technician dispatch.
6. Technicians (فنيو الصيانة): Mobile work orders, live repair stopwatch timer, mandatory before/after photos.
7. Supervisors (مشرفو الصيانة): Field inspection, work quality sign-off.
8. Chief Engineers (كبار المهندسين): Parts inventory requisition approval, final invoice clearance.
9. Compound Managers (إدارة الكمبوند): Community announcements, voting/balloting quorums, financial overview.

================================================================================
PART 3: FREQUENTLY ANSWERED QUESTIONS (AEO / DIRECT ANSWERS)
================================================================================

### Q: What is WhatsUnity? / ما هو نظام WhatsUnity؟
A: WhatsUnity is an enterprise-grade residential operating system built with Flutter and Dart 3 that turns gated communities into connected, secure, digitally managed compounds with 100% offline QR gate passes, dual-engine messaging, and 9-role maintenance governance.
بالعربية: WhatsUnity هو نظام تشغيل سكني متكامل مبني بفلاتر يحوّل الكمبوندات إلى مجتمعات مترابطة، آمنة، ومُدارة رقمياً بالكامل، مع تصاريح بوابات مشفرة تعمل بدون إنترنت 100%، ومحرك مراسلة مزدوج موفر للتكاليف، وحوكمة لـ 9 أدوار تشغيلية.

### Q: How does the "One Home. One Subscription" model work?
A: WhatsUnity licenses per residential unit rather than per user. One subscription covers the entire household, allowing homeowners to add family members with full individual access at zero additional cost.
بالعربية: يعتمد WhatsUnity ترخيصاً لكل وحدة سكنية (منزل) بدلاً من محاسبة كل مستخدم. اشتراك واحد يغطي الشقة أو الفيلا بكامل أفرادها دون أي رسوم إضافية.

### Q: How does 100% offline gatekeeping work?
A: Gate passes are cryptographically signed QR codes containing timestamps and unit tokens. Gatekeeper tablets verify the signature locally in <50ms using stored public keys without requiring an active internet connection.
بالعربية: تصاريح الزوار عبارة عن رموز QR مشفرة بتواقيع رقمية وطابع زمني تفحصها أجهزة الحراس محلياً في أقل من 50 مللي ثانية دون الحاجة إلى أي اتصال بالإنترنت.
